paper_title: How to Generate Popular Post Headlines on Social Media
caption: The average similarities between the headlines from different seasons
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the average similarity of headlines across different time periods. The x-axis, labeled “Δ Days”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 360 days, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 90 days, beginning at 0 and ending at 360. The y-axis, labeled “Avg. Similarity”, has a linear scale ranging from approximately 1.70 to 1.85, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.05. A single line, colored light blue and displayed with solid markers at each data point, decreases from a value of approximately 1.85 at 0 days to roughly 1.70 at 360 days.
